definitions.explanation: Somewhat formal term for a friend from school or university days.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{大学|だいがく}の{学友|がくゆう}です。
examples.english: He is a college friend of mine.

examples.japanese: {学友|がくゆう}と{久|ひさ}しぶりに{再会|さいかい}した。
examples.english: I reunited with an old school friend after a long time.

examples.japanese: {高校|こうこう}{時代|じだい}の{学友|がくゆう}と{今|いま}でも{連絡|れんらく}を{取|と}り{合|あ}っている。
examples.english: I still keep in touch with friends from my high school days.

notes:
A somewhat formal or literary term for a friend from one's school or university days. Combines {学|がく} (learning/school) and {友|ゆう} (friend). While {同級生|どうきゅうせい} or {クラスメート} are more common in everyday speech, {学友|がくゆう} has a warmer nuance emphasizing the bond of having studied together.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大学|だいがく}の{学友|がくゆう}: university friend
- {学友|がくゆう}と{再会|さいかい}する: to reunite with a school friend
- {旧|きゅう}{学友|がくゆう}: old school friend

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {同級生|どうきゅうせい}: classmate — neutral, emphasizes being in the same grade
- {級友|きゅうゆう}: classmate — also somewhat formal, specifically same class
- クラスメート: classmate — casual loanword equivalent
